qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law
qualification.details: Deputy Director: Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialisation; or Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 5 years of post-qualification professional experience, including experience in international engagement / relations, multilateral agency engagement and institutional frameworks. Prior experience of working with Multilateral agencies or in a government international-cooperation cell, and dealing with institutional strategic affairs. Demonstrated experience in managing international partnership agreements or programs, supervising team and senior-level stakeholder relationships, and institutional arrangements. Assistant Director: Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialization; or Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification professional experience, including exposure to any one of: government liaison work, international program coordination, or institutional/ policy matters. Familiarity with documentation cycles (concept notes, progress reports). Experience with documentation, correspondence drafting, and stakeholder coordination in a formal/government or multilateral setting.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the APCRDA Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of APCRDA to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the APCRDA Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download APCRDA Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Deputy Director and 2 for Assistant Director.

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Deputy Director: Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialisation; or Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 5 years of post-qualification professional experience, including experience in international engagement / relations, multilateral agency engagement and institutional frameworks. Prior experience of working with Multilateral agencies or in a government international-cooperation cell, and dealing with institutional strategic affairs. Demonstrated experience in managing international partnership agreements or programs, supervising team and senior-level stakeholder relationships, and institutional arrangements. Assistant Director: Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialization; or Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification professional experience, including exposure to any one of: government liaison work, international program coordination, or institutional/ policy matters. Familiarity with documentation cycles (concept notes, progress reports). Experience with documentation, correspondence drafting, and stakeholder coordination in a formal/government or multilateral setting.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the APCRDA Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of APCRDA to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the APCRDA Recruitment 2026 is 27-08-2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by APCRDA?
faq.answer: APCRDA has released a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Deputy Director and Assistant Director through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy Director post?
faq.answer: For the Deputy Director post, candidates need a Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA) with relevant specialisation or a Master's Degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Economics, Urban Planning, Development Studies, Law, or any other relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Director position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Director position offers a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for APCRDA Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. How many years of experience are required for the Deputy Director post?
faq.answer: For the Deputy Director post, a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification professional experience is required, including experience in international engagement and multilateral agency engagement.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF for APCRDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, labeled as "Official Notification PDF".

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these APCRDA vacancies?
faq.answer: The job type for these vacancies is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of APCRDA?
faq.answer: The official website of Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) is https://crda.ap.gov.in.
